subject: SIG: vendor inventory consolidation and SOC2 contacts for telemetry/support tools
messages:
From: Claire Hartwell <security@acmecloud.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG vendor inventory request — clarification and timeframe

Hi Neha,

Thanks for agreeing to help with Acme's SIG submission. We're preparing our vendor review for a scheduled audit and need Redwood's current list of subprocessors and third-party vendors used in production, telemetry, and support. Specifically we need a CSV with the following columns: vendor name, purpose (cloud/infra, telemetry, support, analytics, CI/CD, backups), data categories processed, country/region of processing, whether vendor has access to production data or logs, SOC 2 / ISO27001 status (or point of contact to obtain evidence), and any downstream subprocessors.

Can you confirm whether you can provide that inventory by EOD 18 Mar? If some items are still being consolidated that's fine — please mark them as provisional. Also flag any vendors that hold customer production data or encryption keys.

Appreciate it — if it's easier we can accept a consolidated CSV and a short cover note explaining gaps.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Hartwell
Security Analyst, Acme Cloud Solutions
security@acmecloud.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hartwell <security@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG vendor inventory request — clarification and timeframe

Hi Claire — thanks for the note.

We maintain a living subprocessor inventory and can produce the CSV you described. I'm attaching a preliminary export (ri_subprocessors_prelim_20260311.csv) with the columns you requested — a few entries are flagged as "procurement verify" where contractual terms are being finalized.

Quick notes:
- Cloud infra: AWS (us-west-2) and GCP (us-east1) are primary; there are a small number of dev/test projects in eu-west-1 used for E2E testing.
- Telemetry: tool names included but we need to confirm retention windows and PII classification for a couple of analytics/metrics providers.
- Support tools: Zendesk is used for customer tickets (access limited, PII redaction on by default), PagerDuty for incident routing (no data storage), and a managed remote-support vendor has temporary session access — we've flagged that in the CSV under "production_access".

@Priyom / @Marissa — can you review the flagged rows and add any procurement notes or vendor contacts so we can include SOC2/attestation contacts in the consolidated file?

If 18 Mar is too aggressive for the final consolidated inventory we can provide a V1 now and a V2 with SOC2 links next week.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security Programs (acting)
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: SIG vendor inventory request — procurement notes and extra vendors

Claire / Neha — adding procurement context.

Attached is a short vendor notes pack (procurement_vendors_notes_20260313.pdf) with contract owners and point-of-contact emails for SOC2 attestations where available. Highlights:
- TelemetryCraft (metrics & usage): only processes aggregated usage metrics; retention 90 days; contact: legal@telemetrycraft.com. No PII, no access to raw request payloads.
- Zendesk (support): access to ticket snippets and fields we surface; PII is redacted in many flows but certain customers opt into sending logs in tickets — marked as "possible PII" in CSV. SOC2 Type II available via vendor portal (procurement has access).
- RemoteSupportCo (remote-session vendor): temporary session tokens; technicians get ephemeral access to instances for troubleshooting — flagged as "production_access: yes" and requires SSO.

Action items: Neha, please confirm whether the RemoteSupportCo sessions are logged to our central audit logs (they are) and whether keys are in KMS (they are in a dedicated KMS keyring).

Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the details. A couple of quick clarifications before we mark the SIG as complete:
1) Which support/remote vendors have the ability to view customer production data (not just metadata or ticket text)? Please call out any vendor that can access logs or S3 buckets.
2) For each vendor that holds or processes production data, can you provide the SOC 2 report link or the contact who can provide the inspection package? Our SOC2 checklist requires the auditor contact or download link.

If you can reply with a short yes/no per vendor and a contact/link by EOD 18 Mar that would be ideal. Thanks — Claire

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hartwell <security@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG vendor inventory request — consolidated inventory and SOC2 contacts (final)

Hi Claire — attached is the consolidated inventory (ri_subprocessors_consolidated_20260318.csv). Key summary below:

- Cloud providers: AWS (us-west-2), GCP (us-east1), limited eu-west-1 test projects. Both are infrastructure providers and have standard SCCs in place; SOC2 reports are available via their portals (links provided in CSV).
- Telemetry/analytics: TelemetryCraft — no PII, retention 90 days, SOC2 contact: legal@telemetrycraft.com. Metrics are aggregated; no raw payloads stored.
- Support tools: Zendesk — may contain customer-submitted logs (possible PII). SOC2 report available: procurement has portal access; contact: zendesk-portal@redwood.ai. PagerDuty — incident routing only, no log storage.
- Remote session vendor (RemoteSupportCo): has ephemeral session access; production session activity is recorded to our central audit logs (yes) and session artifacts are stored encrypted in a KMS-backed bucket. SOC2 evidence available via vendor contact listed in CSV.

We have flagged three vendors as "production_data_access: yes" in the CSV: RemoteSupportCo, Zendesk (in opt-in flows), and BackupProviderX (encrypted backups). For each we've included the vendor SOC2 contact or portal link in the consolidated CSV.

Next steps:
- Claire: please confirm whether the level of detail is sufficient for your SIG review or if you need vendor attestations attached directly. We can provide direct SOC2 attestations via secure upload or procurement can broker NDA'd access if required.
- Priyom / Marissa / Vivek: please chase any missing SOC2 links and share the direct download links with Claire if possible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security Programs (acting)
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
